scope: Source-only Arena/BitSet decision associations; no execution rerun

decisions.structure: CSharp RuntimeArena carries pointer/used/capacity; SLG canonical arena aggregate carries the same fields and shared runtime helpers mutate canonical storage slots. Function dispatch selects the actual arena constructor before ordinary calls.
decisions.branches: Signed versus unsigned input widening, negative size, zero initial capacity, nonzero power-of-two alignment, padding/end overflow, capacity fit versus growth, and byte offset below used.
decisions.logic: Both allocate at least one byte initially, compute offset by checked unsigned alignment, grow to max(doubled,end), copy used bytes then release the old allocation and publish new fields. SLG isolates failure/growth CFG in helpers while preserving caller predecessor identities.
decisions.diagnostics: Invalid signed dimensions, alignment, unsigned wrap, out-of-bounds byte access and allocation failure trap. Existing target capability admission remains separate. This is source comparison of the named64-bit paths, not a new runtime or wasm claim.
decisions.completionScope: Named source-decision connection only; no new runtime, allocation, whole phase or platform acceptance credit.

decisions.structure: CSharp fixed inline bitset storage and SLG canonical bitset aggregate use64-bit words. Mutation targets the existing owner slot or mutable-borrow parameter; readonly operations consume the current aggregate.
decisions.branches: Contains, set, remove, count and declared bit count; in-range versus invalid index; readonly aggregate versus mutable slot; whole-word versus final partial-word count.
decisions.logic: Both select word index>>6 and bit index&63, use1<<bit for contains/or/clear, mask unused tail bits before ctpop and return the summed count as i32. SLG explicitly widens/sign-checks an index before unsigned bound comparison; the canonical CSharp i32 unsigned comparison rejects the same negative indices.
decisions.diagnostics: Invalid index traps before storage access; final-bit masking prevents padding bits contributing to count. No heap materialization is introduced by the SLG read/mutation paths. No execution or whole file branch-coverage claim.
decisions.completionScope: Named source-decision connection only; no new runtime, allocation, whole phase or platform acceptance credit.
